title.narrative: Phase Two of Community Assistance as Part of the New United Nations Approach to Cholera in Haiti

description.narrative:
Community Assistance as Part of the New United Nations Approach to Cholera in Haiti - project is implemented jointly by UNDP and UNOPS. UNDP has previous expertise and experience in working with communities and is leading local consultations in the selected priority communes while UNOPS is leading the implementation of the community projects selected by the administrative sections, infrastructure projects and procurement being its specialty. 

The overall objective is to expand local consultations and community assistance through providing material support to those Haitians and their communities most directly affected by cholera. 
i) undertake local consultations in priority communes with cholera victims and their families, affected communities, including local representatives, formal and informal leaders and vulnerable groups; 
ii) undertake participatory community assessments, 
iii) implement the community projects, and 
iv) ensure capacity development for sustainable community management of the projects.

UNOPS provides technical support during consultations, especially during identification of and selection of community projects.
